points.quote: AFFiNE stores each document as a Yjs CRDT, a `Y.Doc` whose content is a tree of shared types.
Changes from other users or tabs arrive as storage `update` events. `onStorageUpdate` schedules an `apply` job, which calls Yjs `applyUpdate` on the doc. The editor then re-renders from the doc.
Persisted data is binary Yjs updates, not JSON or plain text.
Awareness (cursors and presence) uses a separate channel.
In the browser, IndexedDB holds a database named `workspace:<id>` ... In the desktop (Electron) and mobile apps, SQLite is used instead (`impls/sqlite`).
`sync/doc/peer.ts` syncs the local storage with each remote peer by running connect, pull, push, pullAndPush and save jobs. ... The cloud peer is `CloudDocStorage` (`impls/cloud/doc.ts`).
